args.body: Use the existing catalogue acceptance mission and operator reply packet. Check for an existing approved reply containing the verified worked example. If absent and the independent rehearsal and bilingual readback support it, prepare a copy-ready optional EN/FR insert for an eligible incoming catalogue inquiry. Show the fictional duplicate-image warning, the editor's manual row lookup and URL comparison, and the 12 passing checks after the edit. Verify the exact warning and result against the committed rehearsal. Keep the existing terms and item 4 decision intact. Save and read back the insert and its evidence. Use it only through the authorized private workflow for an eligible inquiry. Track preparation, sending, acceptance and Treasury settlement separately.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The feedback feed reports zero classified requests, five unclassified sources and ten unexplained skips in the latest mail cycle. Demand remains unknown. The New Zealand pilot closed after a bounded check, so its result applies to the notices examined.
